# I-21 additive pulses. Do not edit I-18 / I-16 / I-10B / I-14 on_actions.
# TUR yearly pulse is autumn, not 1 January — .1 is monthly so it does not
# share that day with I-23.1/.2.

on_yearly_pulse_country = {
	on_actions = {
		sp_i21_yearly_events
	}
}

on_monthly_pulse_country = {
	on_actions = {
		sp_i21_monthly_events
	}
}

sp_i21_yearly_events = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:TUR ?= this
				game_date >= 1850.1.1
				NOT = { has_variable = sp_i21_arc_closed }
			}
			set_variable = sp_i21_arc_closed
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = sp_i21_eastern_local_authority
				}
				remove_modifier = sp_i21_eastern_local_authority
			}
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = sp_i21_porte_administrative_reach
				}
				remove_modifier = sp_i21_porte_administrative_reach
			}
		}
	}
	events = {
		sp_i21.2
		sp_i21.3
		sp_i21.4
	}
}

sp_i21_monthly_events = {
	events = {
		sp_i21.1
	}
}
